newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Gold Fields bids for JCI coal.
newsitem.headline: Gold Fields bids for JCI coal.

text.p: Mining house Gold Fields of South Africa said on Tuesday it had made an offer to buy the coal interests of JCI Ltd.
The firm added that it may restructure its coal operations, called Gold Fields Coal Ltd, if the bid proved successful.

"The company has submitted an offer to JCI Ltd to acquire JCI's coal interests. Should this offer be accepted, it is likely to lead to a restructuring of the coal interests within the Gold Fields group," the firm said in a statement.

JCI's wholly-owned coal subsidiary, Tavistock Colliery Ltd, recently acquired Shell South Africa's coal business for 440 million rand, which it said at the time would complement Tavistock's export drive.
Gold Fields said it would publish more details on the JCI coal offer in due course and warned its shareholders and those of Gold Fields Coal to use caution when dealing in their shares.
